transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hi Alex. Can you tell me how long things have been difficult?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Years. Eight or nine. I've done four medications and a lot of therapy. Nothing has really moved it.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Your intake shows a hospital stay in 2019.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I was inpatient for about ten days. That was the worst it's been.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Any thoughts of hurting yourself now?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Not actively. It crosses my mind sometimes but I wouldn't do anything.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Thank you for telling me. Any heart problems?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Alex, I'm Rebecca. Your scores are high - 22 depression, 18 anxiety - and you've been through a lot of options already. I do want to try this with you.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: How long until I know if it's working?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Most people get a sense within three to six weeks, but the first fortnight can be bumpy - nausea, sleep changes, sometimes feeling a bit worse before better.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: I know. Here's what I'll ask of you: do the daily check-ins honestly, including the hard questions. That's how I see you between visits.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: [note to file] High baseline severity with prior inpatient admission and passive ideation on screening. I want close monitoring through the first month. If his scores climb rather than fall, or he goes quiet, bring him in early - do not simply titrate upward. Booking follow-up at 6 weeks but happy to see him sooner.

notes.clinical_summary: 31M, treatment-resistant MDD with anxiety, 8-9 year history, four prior medication trials, inpatient admission 2019. PHQ 22 / GAD 18. Passive ideation on screening, no plan or intent. No cardiac history.
notes.plan: Approve. Start 15mg (60mg troche). Daily check-ins, honesty emphasised. 30-day supply. Close monitoring first month: if scores worsen or contact lapses, escalate and bring visit forward rather than increasing dose. FU booked 6 weeks.
